title: Referral Intake Criteria: Entry Requirements and Open-Referral Limits by Referral Type
content:
Linden Ridge Medical Group holds every Referrals & Prior Authorizations case as one of seven referral types. A case is opened as a given type only when that type's entry requirements are met on the records, and each type sets how many cases of it a patient may hold open for one specialty.

## Entry requirements

| Referral type | Every one of these must hold |
|---|---|
| In-Group Specialist Referral | the rendering provider is a Linden Ridge clinician; the ordering clinician is a Linden Ridge clinician |
| HMO Specialist Referral | the patient's billing account is on the Commercial HMO/EPO Account tier; the referring clinician is the patient's primary care clinician of record |
| Standing Specialist Referral | a chronic or complex condition is documented; the referring clinician is the patient's primary care clinician of record; the patient has at least 2 prior specialist visits |
| Out-of-Network Referral | a network gap is documented; the cost-share acknowledgement is signed; the patient is insured |
| Physical Therapy Episode Authorization | a therapy order is on file; the initial evaluation is completed; the patient is insured |
| Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization | an imaging order is on file; clinical notes are attached; the patient is insured |
| Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization | a procedure order is on file; clinical notes are attached; the patient is insured |

## Open-referral limits and network-gap figures

| Referral type | Open cases allowed per specialty | Duplicate window (calendar days after an approval) | Chronic condition required | Network-gap distance (miles) | Network-gap wait (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| In-Group Specialist Referral | 1 | 30 | No | 0 | 0 |
| HMO Specialist Referral | 1 | 30 | No | 0 | 0 |
| Standing Specialist Referral | 1 | 90 | Yes | 0 | 0 |
| Out-of-Network Referral | 1 | 30 | No | 45 | 30 |
| Physical Therapy Episode Authorization | 1 | 30 | No | 0 | 0 |
| Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization | 2 | 14 | No | 0 | 0 |
| Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization | 2 | 30 | No | 0 | 0 |

**Definitions used in the table.**

- *Open cases allowed per specialty* is the most cases of the type a patient may hold open for one specialty, where an open case is one in status requested, submitted, approved or appealed.
- *Duplicate window* is the number of calendar days after an approval within which a new request of the type for the same specialty is treated as a duplicate while units remain on the approved case.
- *Chronic condition required* states whether a documented chronic or complex condition is required for the type.
- *Network-gap distance* is the distance beyond which the nearest in-network specialist establishes a network gap, and *network-gap wait* is the wait for the first in-network appointment beyond which a network gap exists. A figure of 0 means the measure does not apply to the type.

## Reading the limits (illustrations on hypothetical cases)

- A patient holding one open Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization for one specialty is below that type's limit of 2; a second open authorization of the type for the same specialty reaches the limit.
- A patient holding one open HMO Specialist Referral for cardiology has reached that type's limit of 1 for cardiology.
- For the Out-of-Network Referral, a nearest in-network specialist 50 miles away is beyond the 45-mile figure; one 45 miles away is not beyond it. A first in-network appointment 31 days away is beyond the 30-day figure; one exactly 30 days away is not beyond it.
